origine_fr: L'homme 亻 et 共, écrit 龷 sur 八, qui donne le son : disposer, pourvoir. 共 se lit gòng et donne toujours le son gōng. Mettre les choses à disposition : fournir, puis offrir.
origine_en: A person 亻 and 共, written 龷 over 八, which gives the sound: to set out, to provide. 共 is read gòng and still gives the sound gōng. Making things available: to supply, then to offer.
